name: TerraScope-Bench
description: TerraScope-Bench measures model performance on earth-observation / remote sensing tasks using satellite and aerial imagery. It evaluates visual understanding across multiple sub-tasks such as scene classification, segmentation and object detection, with emphasis on generalization across sensors, geographies and scales. The benchmark is designed to test robustness of vision models on geospatial imagery.
reputation: An emerging remote-sensing benchmark with growing interest among the geospatial and computer-vision communities but not yet widely adopted outside that niche.
